purpose: Machine-readable authority for critical end-to-end SongChart product-flow intersections. It records whether adjacent subsystems are actually connected and how that connection is verified.

audit.rule: Statuses describe current repository behavior, not roadmap intent. Missing chart-intelligence edges are recorded as missing because existing Discovery authority explicitly excludes Stage 17 chart-intelligence metrics until read models and metric contracts exist.

edges.verification: Existing implemented public search flow consumes SearchCatalog through action/controller boundaries.
Search queries canonical entity model classes directly and emits canonical_id plus PublicEntityUrl; there is currently no separate search index requiring reindex propagation.
Discovery projection rebuilds are versioned/bounded, have source version and generated/expiry timestamps, and are separately verified.
Canonical public URLs are emitted from one helper; the Stage 22 golden flow still needs a browser-level assertion that song/artist/search/SEO identity agrees for a real admitted fixture.

editorial_correction_propagation.product_outcome: A governed editorial correction converges all dependent projections without manual database repair.

edges.verification: Stage 20/21 governed admission application and browser review coverage.

Admission apply updates canonical state but does not dispatch or invoke Discovery projection rebuild/invalidation.
